Southwest General green room sandwiches.d: Egg salad with watercress, and cucumber with cream cheese, on soft white bread. Crusts off, cut in triangles.

Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.n: Greek red pepper and feta spread
Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.d: Broiled black, peeled, whipped smooth with feta, plain yogurt, garlic, hot chili flakes and olive oil. Sesame crackers.

Les's farm roast chicken.d: Butter, grated lemon peel and thyme under the skin. Carved to order. The spuds go underneath to brown in the drippings.

Strawberry shortcake.d: Biscuits baked here today, split and piled with sugared berries and soft whipped cream.

Dorothy Michaels' Russian caravan tea.d: Brewed strong and black, poured into glasses. Sliced lemon and cherry preserves on the side, to stir in.
Dorothy Michaels' Russian caravan tea.note: Poured all day in the Rehearsal Hall.
